resolvedQuestions.text: How does Pi's /models picker resolve providers and models from config files, models-store, auth.json, and custom providers?
resolvedQuestions.summary: Interactive command is /model; CLI dump is --list-models. Roster = built-in catalogs + models-store.json cache + models.json overlay + registerProvider, filtered by auth.json/env/--api-key. No built-in Cursor or Devin provider.

resolvedQuestions.text: Can Cursor subscription auth (cursor-agent OAuth, CURSOR_API_KEY, ~/.cursor stores) be reused by a Pi adapter or third-party client without violating ToS or account safety?
resolvedQuestions.summary: No for OAuth/access-token reuse against api2.cursor.sh (staff ToS §1.5, ban risk). Official User API keys work only through harness clients (CLI/SDK/Cloud Agents), not raw /v1/chat/completions.

resolvedQuestions.text: Can Devin OAuth (devin auth login, ~/.local/share/devin/credentials.toml) be reused similarly by a Pi adapter or gateway?
resolvedQuestions.summary: credentials.toml holds windsurf_api_key vs server.codeium.com; copying among own machines is documented, feeding it to Pi as HTTP is not. Public API is session REST; ACP is stdio. Cognition ToS 2.3 analog.

resolvedQuestions.text: Can a local OpenAI-compatible gateway front cursor-agent or the Devin CLI so Pi treats it as a custom provider in /models?
resolvedQuestions.summary: Yes to list via models.json or streamSimple spawning official CLIs. Nested harness makes it a poor native model. Private-endpoint gateways remain ToS-blocked.

resolvedQuestions.text: Which path is technically feasible and account-safe, and how should the three paths be ranked?
resolvedQuestions.summary: Do not ship native /model. Keep cli-cursor/cli-devin dispatch. Reject token reuse and private proxies. CLI-front/streamSimple is experiment-only. Official public APIs are session/harness products.

keyFindings.label: Picker command is /model; CLI dump is --list-models
Three files compose roster: models.json overlay, models-store cache, auth.json credentials
Live catalogs are HTTP LLM APIs not sibling-CLI wrappers; no cursor/devin strings
Cursor staff: Oh My Pi / private-endpoint OpenAI proxies violate ToS §1.5; ban risk
Official Cursor out-of-IDE surfaces always run the agent harness, not raw completions
Devin credentials.toml uses windsurf_api_key against server.codeium.com; public API is session REST
Pi models.json can list a localhost OpenAI-compatible CLI-spawn gateway
Nested Pi+vendor harness collapses tool-calling and adds agent-turn latency
Do not ship native /model; keep executor dispatch; reject token reuse and private proxies
Parent purpose cannot be met by a ToS-safe raw /model provider
